name: umbraco-setup
title: Umbraco Setup (add-on)
description: Umbraco-specific tasks layered on top of standard-delivery. Its Features share standard-delivery's names, so applying it afterwards adds these tasks inside the existing Infrastructure setup and Project Management tickets in the core delivery phase.

variables.name: domain_name
variables.description: The project's primary domain name, e.g. example.com

variables.name: delivery_list
variables.description: Task list (project phase) for the core delivery

tasks.title: Infrastructure setup ({{domain_name}})
tasks.description: Environments, tooling and third-party accounts the build depends on.

tasks.title: Project Management
tasks.description: Project management and ceremonies for the life of the project.

subtasks.title: Client CMS training & handover
subtasks.description: Train the customer's editors on Umbraco, hand over credentials and documentation, and confirm who to contact for support.
